sources.title: Anton Kapustin, Brian Willett, and Itamar Yaakov, Exact Results for Wilson Loops in Superconformal Chern-Simons Theories with Matter
sources.locator: §2 Setup and §2.2 matter (PDF pp. 3–8); §§3.1–3.5 (PDF pp. 7–20); §4 through Eq. (4.4) (PDF pp. 20–22); Appendix B, Eqs. (B.1)–(B.4) for the pure-U(N) Gaussian contour caveat.

contents.name: §2 Setup: Euclidean N=2 vector multiplet, integer Chern-Simons level normalization, and round S3 background
contents.support: The postulate specifies the round sphere, vector multiplets, fundamental-trace level convention, selected supercharge, and its formal field-theory scope.

contents.name: §2.1 Supersymmetric Wilson loop construction
contents.reason: This assigned pair concerns partition functions and their Cartan integral; it makes no Wilson-loop insertion or BPS Wilson-loop expectation claim.

contents.name: §2.2 Chiral matter action, conformal curvature term, and ABJM field content
contents.support: The postulate names the four bifundamental chiral multiplets, their canonical R-charge, the radius-dependent curvature coupling, and ABJM interaction.

contents.name: §3.1 Gauge localization, source Q-exact deformation, fixed locus, and gauge-fixing caveat
contents.support: The postulate records the adopted gauge-fixed supersymmetry, formal measure invariance assumptions, constant Cartan locus, and Weyl quotient.

contents.name: §3.2–3.3 Vector determinant and U(N) real Cartan integral
contents.support: The example uses the root determinant, real eigenvalue contour, and inverse Weyl-group factor in the source convention.

contents.name: §3.4–3.5 Matter localization and zeta-regularized chiral determinant
contents.support: The example multiplies the canonical-dimension chiral determinants for two conjugate bifundamental pairs and keeps the FI/phase qualification source-specific.

contents.name: §4 ABJM gauge group, levels, bifundamental weights, and partition matrix integral
contents.support: The example reproduces the source's two-level phase and hyperbolic factors for equal-rank ABJM.

contents.name: Appendix B pure-U(N) Gaussian evaluation and infinitesimal level prescription
contents.reason: The appendix treats pure U(N) Chern-Simons and its Gaussian regulator; it does not define a joint regulator for the opposite-level ABJM integral.

sources.title: Marcos Mariño, Lectures on Localization and Matrix Models in Supersymmetric Chern-Simons-Matter Theories

contents.name: §2.1–2.3 N=2 Chern-Simons conventions, vector multiplet, and chiral multiplet
contents.support: The postulate states the canonical chiral dimension and the assigned R-charge convention. Mariño writes the opposite sign for the scalar R generator; only Delta=1/2 enters the zero-background one-loop determinant, so the conversion is recorded explicitly in the batch note.

contents.name: §2.4 ABJM gauge factors, bifundamental matter, and quartic superpotential
contents.support: The postulate fixes the equal-rank U(N) factors, opposite levels, four bifundamentals, and the quartic interaction.

contents.name: §6 Localization assumptions and separation of formal deformation from continuum construction
contents.support: The postulate retains the source's Q-invariant measure, boundary-term, and formal path-integral assumptions.

contents.name: §6.2 Gauge-sector localization, gauge fixing, root determinant, and radius rescaling
contents.support: The example uses the Cartan variables, Weyl measure, vector determinant, and dimensionless radius rescaling.

contents.name: §6.3 Canonical-dimension chiral one-loop factor
contents.support: The example applies the zeta-regularized Delta=1/2 determinant to the four bifundamental chirals.

contents.name: §6.4 Chern-Simons matrix-model measure and level parameter
contents.support: This passage fixes the (g_s=2pi i/k) convention and normalized real Cartan measure used to cross-check the example.

contents.name: §6.5 ABJM matrix integral
contents.support: The equal-rank specialization and the (k_{Marino}=-k_{KWY}) sign conversion reproduce the displayed formula.
